overall:
The sample follows the glossary very closely. I found 4 problems in 4 of 124 rows, all isolated, and no rule is broken systematically.

These all match the glossary in every row:
- The fixed formula in all three fields, including bracketed missing words such as [Sakramento apeigomis], [pakrikštijo kūdikį, vardu], [kaime] and [teisėtų sutuoktinių].
- "pakrikštijo kūdikį, vardu" for single children, and the twins construction in 0212_R2 (dvynius kūdikius, vardais; sūnūs (dvyniai), gimę; Pirmojo/antrojo kūdikio krikštatėviai).
- Book 22 clergy forms and rank order (vietinis kunigas, vietinis kunigas vikaras/altaristas, vietinis klebonas kunigas, vietinis diakonas Kierpowski; Mongird, Wojnowicz, Wojtkiewicz, Pacewicz, Beresniewicz, Stefanowicz, Szyłejko). No Jacewicz appears.
- Numeric year–month–day dates with "metų"/"dieną", and the placeholder vocabulary ([?], [neįskaitoma], [nenurodyta], [taip parašyta], [tekstas nutrūksta]).
- Fixed village forms from 4.4 (Judeikų, Pruselių, Narvoišų, Kansudų, Vištovianų, Olksnianų, Pokutovianų and others) and Kulių parapijos.
- Maiden names after "gim." in the nominative feminine form, and unmarried mothers fully in the genitive (valstietės … -ovnos).
- Godmother tags placed after the name (, mergina / , našlė / , [husband gen.] žmona), Template B for the soldier father in 0176_L2, and the singular-or-plural godparent status words.

The four problems:
- A missing bracketed type word in 0005_R1.
- A place-type word that is not in 4.1 ("vietovėje") in 0072_R3.
- A Lithuanian -o genitive added to an undeclinable base ("Gaileso") in 0136_L2.
- An impossible genitive "Šlioų" in 0193_R5, which also does not match "Šlio" in 0140_L4.

Two other possible principle-2 inconsistencies probably come from different source spellings, so I did not count them as errors, but they are worth checking against the images:
- The godmother's husband Benediktas is "Virketio" in 0026_R1 but "Virket [?]" in 0087_R2.
- The father "Marcelio [?] Junzil [?]" in 0160_L2 sits beside "Marcelijus [?] Jundzil [?]" in 0051_R3.
